# Cross-Platform Observability Triage

1. Normalize the incident window and affected service.
2. Correlate Azure Monitor/App Insights signals with Dynatrace MCP service/problem evidence.
3. Build a concise timeline with confirmed findings and confidence.
4. Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses.
